Question 7

Mike purchased an 80's baseball card for $50. If the value of the card increases by 8% each year, what expression gives the card's value after 10 years?

a
 10⋅(0.08)5
b
 10⋅(1.8)50
c
 50⋅(1.08)10
d
 10⋅(0.8)50
e
 50⋅(1.8)10
